name: Deep dive: a long branch first, a short route second
note: Unit costs, goal G. Alphabetical MoveGen puts the long branch S–A–C–D–E–G first. DFS dives down it and returns that 5-edge path (6 picks); BFS returns S–B–F–G with 3 edges. DFID needs bounds 0, 1, 2, 3 (1 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 16 expansions, S is expanded in every round) to find S–B–F–G. Depth-bounded DFS with bound 2 finds nothing, because the goal is at depth 3; with bound 3 it finds S–B–F–G only after the long branch has been cut off at D.
